_comment: Authors whose series metadata was hand-verified. 'book_count' is the count at the time of that review. The sync checks this list: if an author's book count has grown since, it flags the author on the admin page so a human can check whether the new book(s) belong in the series and set the series name/number in Calibre. This file is updated whenever the series metadata for an author is reviewed again.
